title: Plan: deleting a category asks for a destination category and moves its transactions and assigned money there (YNAB popup); nothing ever becomes uncategorized by a delete
notes:
Delete is YNAB's three-case dialog (docs/ynab-plan-parity.md §2), end to end.

## Contract change
`budget_categories_delete` (DELETE /categories/:id) gains an OPTIONAL
`destination_id` query parameter; still `noContent`, still `kind: destructive`,
still `EXPOSE_ALL`. New codes: `category_needs_destination` (409) and
`invalid_destination_category` (400), each with an en + pt-BR message.
With `destination_id` the handler moves everything in ONE transaction; without
it, a category that a row still names is refused (409) instead of being
tombstoned. An already-deleted category that still holds rows is accepted when a
destination is given — that is the "Deleted categories" repair path.

## Rules decided
- trigger for the dialog: live transaction legs (incl. split legs), scheduled
  rows, scheduled split legs, repeat templates, assigned money of any sign.
- destination must be live, visible, non-internal and outside the card-payments
  group — `categoryAssignability` already owns that rule, reused unchanged.
- the move re-points: transactions, subtransactions, scheduled_transactions,
  scheduled_subtransactions, txn_repeat_rules, category_suggestions,
  categorize_decisions, payees.default_category_id (renaming rules are text
  matches on the imported name, left alone).
- assignments are summed per month into the destination's own row (upsert-sum).
- targets are DROPPED (carrying one would silently change what the destination
  asks for); month notes are APPENDED to the destination's note for that month,
  never overwriting the person's words.
- a card's payment category is still hidden, never deleted (409
  `payment_category_not_deleted`, same `isCardPaymentsGroup` reader as before).
- the Plan's "Deleted categories" row gains one action, "Move to a category…",
  sending every stranded category through the same SQL path.

## Casa clone, one case-3 delete (Farmacia -> Mercado Livre), before -> after
Measured on a clone (budgetnew_test_euff, dumped + restored, dropped after).
- transactions: 25 on the source -> 0; destination 68 -> 93 (+25)
- transaction net: source -7.959.060 milliunits -> destination
  -28.983.920 -> -36.942.980 (delta = -7.959.060, exact)
- assigned months merged: 2025-03 909.620+790.000=1.699.620; 2025-05 1.000.000
  (new); 2025-06 820.490 (new); 2025-10 627.390+959.230=1.586.620;
  2026-11 -1.715.160+1.370.540=-344.620 — total assigned unchanged 74.464.870
- uncategorized transactions: 3.415 -> 3.415; rows stranded on deleted
  categories: 0 -> 0; every month's assigned total unchanged (the only delta in
  the run is the seeded case-2 category, -500.000)
- Ready to Assign in the live app: R$ 134.027,91 before, R$ 134.027,91 after.
- case 2 (money only): dialog verbatim, RTA R$ 134.027,91 -> R$ 134.527,91
  (+R$ 500,00 = the category's assignment).
- case 1 (nothing): no dialog, row gone.
